title: Upgrade provider-proxmox-bpg past async-callback status-write conflict bug, then unpause EnvironmentVMs
notes: Paused via crossplane.io/paused annotations in k8s/charts/crossplane-proxmox/templates/{workstation,windows,talos-pc01}.yaml (commit 4df62139) to stop a ~1.5 RV-bumps/s status-write conflict storm (upjet async-callback vs reconcile self-conflict on EnvironmentVM workstation/windows/talos-pc01) that kept kube-apiserver at ~3 cores and macintel01 at 100% CPU. Provider pkg: xpkg.upbound.io/valkiriaaquaticamendi/provider-proxmox-bpg:v1.15.0. Unpause = revert the three annotation blocks.
